cards.ex: The election has devolved into a mud slinging contest, with both candidates attacking each other's character.
cards.exUz: Saylovlar bir-birining shaxsiyatiga hujum qilayotgan nomzodlar bilan qora piar musobaqasiga aylanib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Siyosatchilarning bir-biriga qora piar qilishlari, yomonlash harakatlari.

cards.ex: He's being criticized for his flip-flop on environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: U atrof-muhit qoidalariga nisbatan tez-tez fikrini o'zgartirgani uchun tanqid qilinmoqda.

cards.ex: We need to level the playing field so that smaller parties have a chance.
cards.exUz: Kichikroq partiyalar imkoniyatga ega bo'lishi uchun imkoniyatlar tengligini ta'minlashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The bandwagon effect helped propel his campaign to victory.
cards.exUz: Ommaviylik ta'siri uning kampaniyasining g'alabasiga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy qo'llab-quvvatlash natijasida ommaga ergashish tendensiyasi.

cards.ex: Critics slammed the bill for its pork barrel spending.
cards.exUz: Tanqidchilar qonun loyihasini keraksiz xarajatlari uchun qoraladilar.
cards.uzDef: Siyosatchilarning o'z okrugi uchun keraksiz xarajatlari.

cards.ex: The president's honeymoon period is already over.
cards.exUz: Prezidentning asal oyi allaqachon tugadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi saylangan prezidentning dastlabki oylari, odatda mashhur bo'ladi.

cards.ex: The spin doctor tried to downplay the scandal.
cards.exUz: So'z ustasi janjalni kamaytirishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealarni siyosiy jihatdan foydali qilib ko'rsatuvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: The prime minister faces a vote of no confidence.
cards.exUz: Bosh vazir ishonchsizlik votumiga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatga ishonchsizlik bildirish uchun ovoz berish.

cards.ex: The president is now a lame duck.
cards.exUz: Prezident endi ojiz o'rdak.
cards.uzDef: Vakolati tugayotgan va ta'siri kamaygan siyosatchi.

cards.ex: The dictator ruled with an iron fist.
cards.exUz: Diktator temir musht bilan hukmronlik qildi.

cards.ex: The investigation felt like a fishing expedition.
cards.exUz: Tergov hech qanday aniq dalilsiz ma'lumot qidirishga o'xshardi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday aniq dalilsiz ma'lumot izlash.

cards.ex: The agreement contains standard boilerplate clauses.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv standart shartlarni o'z ichiga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun loyihalarida yoki boshqa hujjatlarda ishlatiladigan standart matn.

cards.ex: The candidate built a successful grassroots campaign.
cards.exUz: Nomzod muvaffaqiyatli ommaviy kampaniya qurdi.

cards.ex: Many companies use tax havens to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Ko'p kompaniyalar soliq to'lamaslik uchun soliq jannatidan foydalanadilar.
cards.uzDef: Soliqlar past bo'lgan yoki umuman bo'lmagan davlat.

cards.ex: The pundit class is already predicting the next election.
cards.exUz: Sharhlovchilar sinfi allaqachon keyingi saylovni bashorat qilmoqda.

cards.ex: The two parties decided to bury the hatchet and work together.
cards.exUz: Ikki tomon urushni to'xtatishga va birgalikda ishlashga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: Without funding, the project will go down the drain.
cards.exUz: Moliyalashtirilmasa, loyiha befoyda ketadi.

cards.ex: The campaign is working hard to get out the vote.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya ovoz berishga chaqirish uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.

cards.ex: The redistricting process can be highly political.
cards.exUz: Hududni qayta taqsimlash jarayoni juda siyosiy bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The president will deliver the State of the Union address next month.
cards.exUz: Prezident kelgusi oyda Ahvolot bayonotini taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Prezidentning mamlakat ahvoli haqidagi yillik nutqi.

cards.ex: He emerged as a dark horse candidate in the election.
cards.exUz: U saylovda kutilmagan nomzod sifatida paydo bo'ldi.

cards.ex: The new law will increase the taxpayer burden.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun soliq yuklamasini oshiradi.

cards.ex: The politician is pandering to the voters.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi saylovchilarga xushomad qilmoqda.

cards.ex: He is a power broker in the city's political scene.
cards.exUz: U shahar siyosiy sahnasida ta'sirli shaxs.

cards.ex: His fence-sitting approach frustrated many voters.
cards.exUz: Uning betaraf pozitsiyasi ko'p saylovchilarni xafa qildi.

cards.ex: They're just playing politics with people's lives.
cards.exUz: Ular shunchaki odamlarning hayoti bilan siyosiy o'yinlar o'ynashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z manfaati uchun siyosiy usullardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: He failed to deliver on his campaign promises.
cards.exUz: U saylov va'dalarini bajara olmadi.

cards.ex: There's a lack of political will to address the issue.
cards.exUz: Muammoni hal qilish uchun siyosiy iroda yetishmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun siyosiy tayyorlik.

cards.ex: They exploited a tax loophole to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Ular soliq to'lamaslik uchun soliq qonunidagi kamchilikdan foydalanishdi.

cards.ex: The candidate is trying to win votes by appealing to young people.
cards.exUz: Nomzod yoshlarga murojaat qilib, ovoz yig'ishga harakat qilmoqda.
